data.title: 黍 · 咖啡馆里认真听你说小事
data.description: 周末咖啡馆，黍穿燕麦开衫与钴蓝百褶长裙，坐在你对面听你说话。她放下甜点叉，双手轻轻交叠在桌边，笑意里带一点忍俊不禁；两杯饮料与分享过的蛋糕让画面像一次熟悉的约会。
data.action: 放下甜点叉，双手交叠，带笑专心听镜头位置的你
data.promptProse: Across the cafe table, Shu listens with a barely contained smile, setting down the dessert fork and lightly crossing her hands at the edge. Preserve the oatmeal cardigan, ivory bow-collar blouse and cobalt-blue midi skirt. Two drinks and the shared cake occupy the near side of the eye-level medium view. Behind her, a window frame intersects the top of the booth seat, and the next table is partly hidden by the seat back. Soft window light catches the bronze cardigan buttons and glass rims. The cake plate has a gentle contact shadow, while the booth’s lower upholstery stays darker than the light-facing cushion seam.
